$comment: Desired GitHub state. Consumed by scripts/github/configure-repository.mjs — GitHub does NOT read this file. Edit here, then run the script to apply and verify.

pullRequest.$comment: `applied` is what the rulesets carry now. `target` is the intended end state; it is NOT applied because the repository has a single collaborator and an author cannot approve their own PR, so required_approving_review_count:1 would make every PR unmergeable. See targetBlockedOn.
pullRequest.targetBlockedOn: Add a second repository collaborator with at least Write access (Settings -> Collaborators, or `gh api -X PUT repos/OWNER/REPO/collaborators/USER -f permission=push`). Only an approving review from a user with write access counts toward the gate; until one exists, count:1 blocks every PR including the author's own. Once done, set pullRequest.applied to pullRequest.target and re-run this script.

requiredStatusChecks.$comment: Exact check-run (job) names, confirmed from a real run. doNotEnforceOnCreate lets `cut-release-line` create release/vX.Y (a non-PR push, so no checks can have run on it) while still gating every later push.
